messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick FYI 1  — two interviewers on R-5099 couldn't access the scorecard; button was disabled.
Liam (Recruiting Ops): I see that. The ATS shows two user records with same email but different IDs. Vendor batch probably sent mixed-case emails.
Dev (Platform): Confirmed in webhook logs: `user_upsert` for `sam@acme.com` and `Sam@Acme.com`. Our importer keyed on raw email.
Liam (Recruiting Ops): Because of the duplicate, the scorecard assigner matched only one account. Can you normalize incoming emails before dedupe?
Dev (Platform): Simple change: lowercase emails during import and dedupe on normalized value. Will open a small PR and deploy to staging.
ATS-bot: vendor batch 2026-12-02 processed: 1 warning (email case variance).
Vendor-ops: We'll update our export to lowercase emails on our side too. Sorry about the noise.
Maya (People Ops): For immediate fix Liam — can you attach the interviewer scorecard to the active accounts and re-send training links? Also add a note in the vendor handbook about email casing.
Liam (Recruiting Ops): On it. I attached `sc-210` to the correct accounts and resent the training link. Will run a 7-day audit to confirm fixes.
